design_philosophy: Precision terminal-grade hardware interface meets instant P2P utility. Strict high-contrast monochrome with electric emerald telemetry accents, ultra-crisp 1px borders, tactile micro-surfaces, zero extraneous fluff. Feels like an encrypted peer-to-peer relay tool built for hackers, engineers, and power users who transfer snippets between devices in half a second.

entry_surfaces./: split terminal layout on desktop with persistent QR session HUD panel left, real-time message stream right; on mobile stacked adaptive HUD with quick-scan modal and full-height chat stream

key_components.name: HeaderHUD
key_components.purpose: Displays Beam brandmark, connection state (WebSocket live/polling fallback), peer device status (Phone online / Laptop online / Waiting for peer), latency counter, Auto-copy toggle, and Room actions (Clear All, Unpair/New Room, QR Code modal trigger on mobile).

key_components.name: PairingPanel
key_components.purpose: Left-dock on desktop or drawer/dialog on mobile. Contains large high-contrast QR code (react-qr-code or qrcode.react), click-to-copy pairing URL with hash fragment key, room ID indicator, 24h retention notice, and PWA installation prompt.

key_components.name: MessageStream
key_components.purpose: Scrollable thread of encrypted messages. Handles automatic scroll-to-bottom on new messages, empty state with pairing guidance, and day/hour grouping.

key_components.name: MessageBubble
key_components.purpose: Individual terminal card with sender indicator (My Device vs Peer Device), editable device label tag, timestamp, 1-click Copy button with tactile 'COPIED!' feedback, clickable URL parsing with safe target='_blank', and character counter if long.

key_components.name: MessageComposer
key_components.purpose: Fixed bottom dock with multi-line auto-expanding textarea (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline), instant 'Paste & Send' button reading navigator.clipboard, character count (10,000 max), and clear action feedback.

key_components.name: DeviceLabelEditor
key_components.purpose: Quick inline modal or popover to customize device moniker ('MacBook Pro', 'iPhone 15', 'Pixel 8', 'Work PC'). Persisted in localStorage.

key_components.name: SecurityNoticeBar
key_components.purpose: Crisp terminal banner stating: 'E2E Encrypted (AES-GCM client-side) • Ephemeral 24H memory • Zero user log'.

motion_and_interactions.copy_feedback: Instant green flash badge with scale bump 1.05 -> 1.0 and Sonner toast notification
motion_and_interactions.paste_send_action: Subtle border pulse on composer when paste & send executes
motion_and_interactions.connection_pulse: Subtle green ping ring on the connection status indicator when WebSocket is active
motion_and_interactions.reconnect_spin: Animated loader icon when falling back to polling or attempting reconnection

accessibility_and_contrast.text_contrast: White (#EDEDF0) on #090A0F provides 17.8:1 contrast. Muted text (#8A8F9E) on #090A0F provides 5.4:1 contrast (exceeds WCAG AA 4.5:1).
accessibility_and_contrast.keyboard_navigation: Full tab ordering across composer, action buttons, copy toggles, and modal dialogs.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME: Apply dark-mode by default. Set class='dark' on <html> in frontend/index.html and maintain the terminal dark aesthetic defined in frontend/src/index.css.

2. FONTS: Import '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono' and '@fontsource-variable/geist' in frontend/src/index.css. Use mono for headings, buttons, tags, timestamps, message text, and telemetry. Use Geist for secondary UI descriptions.

3. REAL-TIME & WEBSOCKET: Implement a robust WebSocket manager in frontend/src/lib/websocket.ts that connects to /api/ws/{room_id} with exponential backoff and a 2-second fallback polling interval via TanStack Query when offline.

4. CLIENT-SIDE ENCRYPTION (AES-GCM): Generate a 256-bit encryption key stored in the URL hash fragment (#key=...) when creating a room. Encrypt message payloads in the browser using Web Crypto API before sending over WebSocket/API. Decrypt incoming payloads with the hash key. If URL hash is missing, derive or prompt appropriately.

5. AUTO-COPY FEATURE: Implement the 'Auto-copy incoming text' toggle. When on, invoke navigator.clipboard.writeText on incoming peer messages. Wrap in try/catch to fail silently if the browser permissions block background clipboard writes.

6. PASTE & SEND BUTTON: When clicked, invoke navigator.clipboard.readText(). If text is retrieved, immediately send the message and clear composer. If permission is denied/unavailable, focus the textarea with a helpful toast for manual paste.

7. DEVICE MONIKER: Detect device type using navigator.userAgent (e.g. 'Laptop (Mac)', 'Phone (iOS)', 'Phone (Android)', 'Desktop (Linux)'), allow user to edit and save it to localStorage('beam_device_label'). Attach this label to outgoing messages.

8. 24H EXPIRATION & CLEAR ALL: Messages stored in MongoDB must have a created_at UTC timestamp with a 24-hour TTL index (expireAfterSeconds: 86400). The 'Clear All' action sends a broadcast/DELETE request to delete all messages in the room.
9. PWA CAPABILITY: Include web app manifest (manifest.json), service worker registration, and apple-touch-icon links so users can tap 'Add to Home Screen' on iOS/Android.
10. TESTING COMPLIANCE: Every button, input, toggle, message item, status indicator, and modal MUST contain its exact data-testid as specified in the data_testid_manifest.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered AI-slop layouts or washed-out gradients.
Containers with borders MUST have generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6).
All interactive elements require crisp micro-interactions (:hover, :active, :focus-visible).
No universal 'transition: all' that disrupts transform animations.
All text on dark surfaces must maintain at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background.
Always test both desktop (1280px split view) and mobile (390px full-height stream) responsiveness.
